name: Power-up Capsule
usage: Collectible bonus falling downward when special tiles are broken
prompt: Pixel art bonus power-up capsule, smooth elongated cylindrical pill shape glowing with bright golden-yellow luminescence and an embossed lightning spark icon in the middle. True 90-degree orthogonal overhead view, looking straight down.

name: Magma Core Background
prompt: Atmospheric 16-bit pixel art subterranean volcanic arena background, dark basalt rock walls with glowing veins of molten amber magma and distant heat haze, low contrast dark tones, bounded arcade playfield backdrop, 16:9 widescreen.

name: Astral Cosmos Background
prompt: Ethereal 16-bit pixel art deep space cosmos background, deep violet and midnight space void with scattered twinkling pixel stars and glowing faint purple nebula clouds, low contrast, bounded arcade playfield backdrop, 16:9 widescreen.

name: Crystal Brick Tile
usage: Destructible tile overhead in playfield grid
prompt: Pixel art arcade brick block, stout rectangular beveled tile with glossy metallic borders and a vibrant illuminated inner gemstone surface, crisp high-contrast pixel boundaries. True 90-degree orthogonal overhead view, looking straight down.

name: Neon Cyber Grid Background
prompt: Vibrant 16-bit pixel art dark cyberpunk digital arena background, deep navy and obsidian void with glowing neon cyan floor gridlines and subtle circuit board traces, low contrast, clean bounded playfield backdrop, 16:9 widescreen.

name: Glowing Energy Sphere
usage: Primary bouncing projectile that damages and destroys tiles
prompt: Pixel art glowing arcade energy ball, perfectly circular spherical glowing orb with a pure white luminous core and an outer pulsing cyan neon plasma rim, sharp pixel edges. True 90-degree orthogonal overhead view, looking straight down.

name: Arcade Surge Soundtrack
prompt: 128 BPM, energetic retro 8-bit chiptune arcade soundtrack, pulse wave arpeggios, crisp noise snare and punchy kick, catchy melodic FM lead, bouncy arcade rhythm, seamless instrumental loop

name: Arcade Energy Paddle
usage: Player-controlled movable deflector paddle at bottom of playfield
prompt: Pixel art sleek high-tech defensive arcade paddle, broad and elongated horizontal rectangular silhouette with rounded bevel corners, polished titanium armor plating with glowing neon blue power core strip along the center. True 90-degree orthogonal overhead view, looking straight down. Face right (3 o'clock).
